about: URL-field values checked against a key that needs percent-encoding, run by tools/test_routes.py (server/provider_store.py) and web/lib/provider-api.test.ts (web/lib/provider-api.ts) so both servers refuse the same ones. <KEY> is the key as typed, <KEY_UPPER> and <KEY_LOWER> the key percent-encoded with upper and lower case hex. "refuse" means the save answers 400 with the API-key-field message; "allow" means it is saved.
